about.title: Developer by trade.
about.copy: I'm James, a software developer in Austin, Texas. I've spent my career building business software across .NET, React, Angular, SQL, Azure, APIs, and integrations. Away from the keyboard, I'm usually building something at the house, wiring up another automation, working on a PC, or playing guitar louder than necessary.
